invariant: Titan 2 deployment never inherits Pixel or Panther fastboot assumptions
fastboot boot is unsupported and must never be used as the Titan temporary-boot path
Logical-partition writes require userspace fastbootd proven by is-userspace=yes
Every adb or fastboot device operation is bound to an explicit Titan serial
Host OKAY is never sufficient device-state proof; live unlocked/product/mode state is re-read before write
Virtual A/B does not make an unmaterialized inactive system partition a safe target; current proven path is the active materialized logical system
Dynamic partition queries and targets use slot-qualified logical names such as system_a
A write is blocked unless snapshot-update-status is none before mutation and remains none after mutation
COW partitions are evidence-bearing Virtual A/B state and are never blindly deleted as stale leftovers
The exact registered artifact SHA-256 and logical size are bound to the reviewed flash plan before execution
A verified matched-stock restore path is mandatory before any Titan write-capable scope is opened
A standalone stock system_a flash is forbidden as a stock-restore procedure because it creates a mixed-partition state
Whole-super replacement is negative evidence and is not the primary Sable deployment path
Boot init_boot vendor_boot dtbo vbmeta slot and firmware mutation remain forbidden unless separately evidence-backed and authorized
Userdata erase or factory reset is never implicit and requires a separate explicit destructive authorization
A failed Titan flash is never automatically retried
After write the logical partition size slot fastbootd mode and snapshot state are verified before reboot
The proven bounded flow sends one post-write reboot and stops on fastboot return recovery or timeout instead of fix-forward mutation
New Titan device/recovery helpers avoid errexit/pipefail hardcoded host tools and command-substitution stdout pollution
Titan 2 Elite never inherits Titan 2 physical flash evidence or authorization
Flash changes must review pinned Titan research successful/failed Sable flash history and current canonical deployment PRs
Flash entry never assumes the current device mode; Android and bootloader fastboot transition to verified fastbootd, existing fastbootd is reused, and recovery or ambiguous state fails closed
Canonical Titan flash scripts must pass shell syntax checks and an offline bounded mode-state self-test; transport commands and transitions have hard timeouts and short polling

An N1I-C2 device is qualified from its exact sealed ADB recovery transport without requiring recovery shell or properties and without reboot mode transition flash reset slot LP or AVB mutation; recovery advances only to explicit recovery-to-fastbootd review
